body.title: Sony WH-1000XM4 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones, Black
body.description: Sony’s intelligent industry-leading noise canceling headphones with premium sound elevate your listening experience with the ability to personalize and control everything you hear. Get up to 30 hours of battery life with quick charging capabilities, enjoy an enhanced Smart Listening feature set, and carry conversations hands-free with speak-to-chat.

body.customer_says: Customers praise the headphones' sound quality and excellent noise cancellation. The Bluetooth connectivity receives mixed feedback - while some can connect to two devices simultaneously, others report constant disconnections. Battery life is also mixed, with some finding it incredible while others report charging issues. Comfort opinions are divided, with some noting they can wear them all day without ear pain, while others find them extremely irritating. Value for money opinions are mixed, with some finding them absolutely worth the money while others consider them disappointing for the price.
